_about: One short original rundown per day (YYYY-MM-DD, Central time), written by the morning update. Shown at the top of longhornsdaily.com/archive/<date>.
2026-11-17: Texas is 8-2 (5-2 SEC) after Arch Manning's 4-yard touchdown pass to Raleek Brown with three seconds left beat LSU 22-21 in Baton Rouge on Saturday. The Longhorns host Arkansas at 2:30 p.m. Saturday in their final home game, and Sean Miller's men's team, which edged Baylor 75-72 in San Antonio on Sunday, is back in Moody Center Thursday against Southern Utah.
2026-11-18: No. 6 Texas women's basketball plays at Green Bay tonight, and the unbeaten No. 6 men (4-0) host Southern Utah at Moody Center on Thursday after edging Baylor 75-72. Football, 8-2 and No. 6 in the CFP rankings, hosts 4-6 Arkansas on Saturday. Volleyball added top-ranked outside hitter Ireland Real to its 2027 class, and UT researchers are pushing to protect Brackenridge Field Laboratory in a proposed city land deal.
2026-11-19: No. 6 Texas women's basketball beat Green Bay 89-57 Wednesday behind 23 points from Jayda Clark as Madison Booker returned. The unbeaten No. 6 men host Southern Utah tonight at Moody Center, while football lists Colin Simmons and Warren Roberson as questionable for Saturday's game with Arkansas.
2026-11-20: No. 6 Texas men's basketball stayed unbeaten at 5-0, pulling away from Southern Utah 92-68 behind 26 points from Matas Vokietaitis and 22 from David Punch. Soccer opens the NCAA Tournament tonight against Houston at Myers Stadium, and No. 5 football hosts Arkansas at 2:30 p.m. Saturday in the home finale.
2026-11-22: Texas closed its home schedule with a 45-3 Senior Day win over Arkansas, its fifth straight, but safety Kobe Black and right tackle Andre Cojoe were hurt ahead of Friday's trip to Texas A&M. Today the No. 6 women face No. 19 Ohio State at noon in Fort Worth, No. 15 volleyball meets No. 11 Tennessee in the SEC quarterfinals and the No. 6 men host Southern Indiana at 2 PM.
2026-11-23: Texas is preparing for Friday's 6:30 PM game at Texas A&M on ABC after a 45-3 win over Arkansas, and ESPN's FPI gives the Longhorns an 83.9% chance to win. The men's basketball team heads to San Diego to face Georgetown on Thursday with point guard Isaiah Johnson nursing a glute strain, while the No. 6 women host Southeastern Louisiana on Wednesday.
2026-11-24: It's Lone Star Showdown week: Texas visits Texas A&M Friday at 6:30 PM on ABC, and safety Kobe Black is out for the season while Aggies coach Mike Elko has yet to name a quarterback. The No. 6 women host SE Louisiana Wednesday, and the No. 7 men meet Georgetown on Thanksgiving in San Diego with point guard Isaiah Johnson's status uncertain.
2026-11-26: The No. 6 Texas women moved to 7-0 with a 96-45 win over Southeastern Louisiana, led by 19 points from Jayda Clark. The No. 7 men face Georgetown at 1:30 PM today on FS1 in the Rady Children's Invitational in San Diego, and No. 3 football (9-2) visits Texas A&M Friday at 6:30 PM on ABC.
2026-11-27: Texas plays twice on Black Friday. No. 7 men's basketball, 7-0 after Isaiah Johnson's 26 points beat Georgetown on Thanksgiving, meets Saint Mary's for the Rady Children's Invitational title at 4 p.m. on FOX. No. 3 football then visits 4-7 Texas A&M at Kyle Field at 6:30 p.m. on ABC as a double-digit favorite.
2026-11-28: Texas beat Texas A&M 16-6 at Kyle Field on Friday night behind three Gianni Spetic field goals and an Arch Manning touchdown pass to Cam Coleman, improving to 10-2 and clinching a spot in the SEC Championship Game against No. 1 Georgia on Dec. 5 in Atlanta. On the court, the women visit SEMO on Sunday and both basketball teams face Louisville next week.
